question: Does the checkpoint-only rank-eight H3 reader basis provide a stable sufficient, selective, downstream-transporting circuit variable on wholly new v10 text?

authority.rank7_outcome: Rank seven missed sealed v9 A2 behavior at 89.33%; a regularized eight-parameter compression selected the unchanged rank-seven basis and produced a valid null.
authority.v10_capability: 31 jointly capable A1 rows and 32 jointly capable A2 rows; no rank-eight outcome observed before registration.

frozen_design.basis: Frozen semantic rank two plus the first six orthogonal singular modes of the normalized H3-output-to-L15H5/H1 q/k/q2/k2/v checkpoint reader map. No examples, labels, logits, gradients, or updates define it.
frozen_design.population: Every jointly capable v10 A1/A2 row from the capability manifest.

predictions.pred_a_authority_capability_exact_instru: All hashes, capability, orthonormality, reconstruction, identity, decomposition, finite records, and price pass.
predictions.pred_b_full_h3_is_material: Full H3 has correct direction on at least 90% and at least 30% of live-writer mean recovery in both panels.
predictions.pred_c_rank8_is_behaviorally_sufficient: Rank eight carries at least 90% of full-H3 mean behavior in both panels.
predictions.pred_d_rank8_complement_is_selective: The exact orthogonal complement carries at most 10% absolute full-H3 mean behavior in both panels.
predictions.pred_e_rank8_transports_to_l15_pair: Rank eight carries at least 95% of full-H3 L15H5/H1 response in both panels.

decision: Paired confirmation requires A-E. Failure is reported without rank or threshold adjustment on v10.
